resources.string: HTML supports normalization only, not Validate or Minify.
HTML could not be normalized within the supported parser behavior.

Local full-document normalization, not strict validation or sanitization. The parser repairs malformed HTML and wraps fragments in html/head/body; markup, entities and structure may change. Automatic indentation is disabled to avoid adding text whitespace, but this is not a byte-preserving operation. Preview the result before copying or sharing. Scripts, styles, event handlers and unsafe links remain text: they are not fetched, rendered, executed or removed. Limits: 64,000 input characters, accepted tree depth 64, 20,000 nodes plus attributes and 256,000 output characters.
